literal: I too exist-perhaps in his heart? In my heart, oh, exists-indeed he!
translation: Do I even exist in his heart? In my heart, oh, he constantly dwells!
modern: அவருடைய நெஞ்சத்தில் நானும் இருக்கிறேனா? ஆனால், என் நெஞ்சத்தில் அவரோ எப்போதும் இருக்கிறார்!
explanation: The heroine, suffering from the pain of separation, wonders if she occupies any place at all in her lover's thoughts. She uses the doubtful particle 'கொல்' to question if she exists in his heart. In contrast, she uses the emphatic 'ஏ' and an exclamatory sigh 'ஓஒ' to state that he is permanently and vividly present in her own heart. This contrast beautifully highlights the vulnerability and one-sided intensity of her longing during separation.
